snippet.title: BiteRoyale.io OFFICIAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
PLAY NOW: https://biteroyale.io

Experience the frenzy of BiteRoyale.io - a high-octane Battle Royale adventure crafted for PC and mobile! Team up with friends or go solo in various exciting game modes, within quick matches.

Unlock a diverse array of Foodies, each armed with potent Super abilities! Collect exclusive food-themed skins to flaunt your style as you engage in epic battles across quirky arenas in the Foodieverse.

FIGHT ACROSS EXCITING GAME MODES:

-SOLO/DUO/TRIO/SQUAD Battle Royale: A royale-style face-off for survival. Level up your Foodie, Team up, or go alone—emerge as the last Brawler munching in this intense royale. The ultimate gastronomic showdown!

BE THE #1 FOODIE:
Scale the global leaderboard, proving you're the supreme Foodie of the culinary world!

A WORLD OF DELICIOUS EVOLUTION:
Stay tuned for new Foodies, savory skins, appetizing arenas, special events, and game modes, continually enhancing your gaming banquet.

FEATURES:
Join or create your own Private Match to share with friends and play to dine in victory
Level-up Foodies with collectible cards and coins
From the creators of SandStrike.io, Ferge.io, and Shoter.io, prepare for a mouth-watering brawl in BiteRoyale.io!

Controls:
WASD / Arrow Keys: Move
Left Mouse Click: Attack
